name: payments-api

dependencies.name: internal-payments-api
dependencies.description: Charges customers, issues refunds, and checks payment status for mobile money and card transactions.

dependencies.name: sms-service
dependencies.description: Sends payment-link and payment-confirmation SMS to customers and merchants.

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends payment-link, payment-confirmation and payout-confirmation emails.

description: The single backend for the platform: merchant accounts, payment requests, guest checkout, transactions, refunds, bank accounts and merchant-triggered payouts. Serves both the merchant/admin portal and the public checkout app. Does not talk to mobile-money or card networks directly — all charges route through the internal payments API.
